rows.behavior: Browser OAuth proof, verified-identity linking, and admission/re-entry through the instance email allowlist.
Renew a session without extending its original absolute lifetime, switch to a currently authorized organization, revoke on logout, and distinguish ambient-cookie refresh from explicit-token exchange.
Keep account/profile operations person-session-only and consume an approved CLI device request at most once, including competing polls and issuance failure after consumption.
Create an administrator-managed delegated API key, disclose it once, authenticate by stored hash, and reject expired/revoked credentials.
Use verified tenant scope and current membership/permission rows for transaction-scoped admission, including expiry after lock waits and competing membership/grant writers.
Create a team with owner membership, dedicated docs repository and Base-workspace metadata in one transaction, then materialize repository content.
Issue, accept or revoke organization invitations against pending state, verified identity and expiry; distinguish login-triggered acceptance from immediate existing-user membership.
Refuse membership removal or demotion to viewer while that person owns active workspaces; require explicit transfer or deletion before changing eligibility.
Bind repository-provider connection consent to the person/provider, validate replacement credentials, encrypt stored tokens, and disconnect that provider independently of platform identity.
Resolve org/workspace/user launch settings and scoped provider accounts; preserve account identity and prevent deletion of an assigned account.
Create session/task/initial input atomically; claim a caller request key before mutable persona resolution and return the same original result on equal retries.
Keep pending input editable/withdrawable only before reservation, enforce expected revision, and require an explicit owner decision before initial-input unknown-delivery redelivery.
Admit eligible queued turns with frozen launch choices, completed dependencies and shared agent/command capacity, preserving supplied launch confirmation until dispatch.
Expose a Codex native authentication challenge only under current owner/runtime authority and keep readiness, private credential state and visible challenge status distinct.
Apply task journal events in sequence with duplicate watermarks, reject stale attempt identity, and atomically project accepted user input plus assistant placeholder.
Fork saved conversation history in order with new identities, destination-bound retained attachments and stopped incomplete assistant output, without inheriting queued or native continuation work.
Materialize only current typed attachments after identity/metadata/hash/image validation, pass supported bytes through Claude/Codex native encodings, and fail before delivery on invalid input.
Reserve eligible running-Claude follow-up text without overtaking prior input, bind delivery generation and apply bounded-send disposition while retaining the ordinary queue fallback.
Bind module invocation to catalog, execution identity and capabilities; deduplicate cancelled/settled identities, journal before effects and retain an exact outcome before releasing capacity.
Reconcile recorded usage per tenant and query current provider-account quota observations while leaving workspace spend-enforcement scope explicit.
Durable explicit Start consent survives capacity waits and reconciliation without allowing cancelled, superseded, expired or owner-replaced intent to wake compute.
Stop fences work, captures within its persisted save window, retries transient failures, records unsaved loss without reopening capture, and waits for host termination/release.
Owner inactivity can reclaim ready unused preview compute but not bounded work, preview startup or an open owner terminal; idle admission rechecks current activity.
Admission serializes organization quota and host slots, requires published stable sizing, selects eligible same-region hosts, and derives boot disk capacity with visible override/cap consequences.
Queued authorized demand drives bounded durable managed-host claims, subtracting other usable/in-flight supply; cloud retry rechecks demand and preserves uncertain resource ownership.
Automatic idle retirement requires continuous healthy empty custody, same-region spare capacity and no queued demand; cleanup preserves records and retries failed cloud deletion fairly.
Every Start stages a trusted fresh workspace root; cleanup claims only unheld paths before asynchronous deletion and retains unreaped path holds until proof or fresh replacement.

Host control retries ambiguous commands with the same method/key/payload; concurrent same-key calls serialize, altered payload conflicts, and retained completion survives tunnel loss within its process-local retention window.

Host VM facts and per-VM sequence survive host restart, replay after reconnect, deduplicate with payload integrity, apply current-incarnation effects transactionally, and are removed only after a committed contiguous acknowledgment.
Lease renewal and complete inventory remain bound to the current host/connection/incarnation; duplicate renewal cannot extend expiry and partial heartbeat cannot establish missing-VM death.
OCI content is digest-verified and extracted within the cache root, layer directory semantics are preserved, and complete templates/layers publish atomically before fresh per-VM roots use them.

Shared cache serves only trusted imported/seeded compile artifacts, refuses guest export, reserves temporary bytes before write, holds readers against eviction, and recovers accounting after interrupted fills.

Linux microVM guest egress installs a fail-closed host-local/metadata/link-local denial policy before networking while preserving narrow DNS/cache/API/reply exceptions; explicit development backends retain their stated isolation limits.
Execution journal recovery preserves exact settlements/dispositions, closes lost supervision before listening, and prunes only durably acknowledged prefixes without reusing sequence numbers.
Owner terminals authenticate through the runtime facade, generation-fence reattachment/input, retire a shell with old nonabortable writes, and resume or explicitly reset bounded output offsets.

Preview task intent serializes exclusivity and replay, requires current owner/incarnation and listener readiness, and separates owner Close cleanup from lifecycle shutdown while retaining application exit diagnostics.
Preview browser admission uses the isolated target origin and current owner/incarnation, strips platform authority, confines application cookies, and refuses sibling-origin WebSocket use.
Filesystem RPC mutations own serialized checked publication and bounded replay while native edits remain outside that lock; watches report uncertainty/rescan and retry degraded coverage.

Dirty workspace flush retains one exact member vector and immutable snapshot/local-head cut across retries before completing its receipt; restart recovery uses that saved state without advancing the user branch merely to save.
Workspace read audience and current-owner audience administration
Reversible content read-only transition, drain admission and final quiescence
Fork retries retain one captured source operation and publish only materialized member refs
Owner deletion stops compute and removes a workspace with governing no-orphan cascade semantics
Review starts in a reader-owned child, can resume that child, and retains a created copy if compute start fails
Successive review rounds supersede open snapshot work while preserving valid proposal history
Reviewer can discard selected previewed changes from their own copy without overwriting later work or changing the source
A pushed Approve review verdict can settle listed formal approvals, including a requestless path
Eligible readers publish additive file suggestions with detected-stale confirmation and no source write
Selected review acceptance preserves applied truth across failed publication and interrupted settlement
Update keeps the G5 PR identity; known terminal provider PR replacement requires explicit Create replacement
Provider merge recovery imports accepted pinned source history without silently accepting a changed target history
Issue creation handles unknown provider outcomes and separate parent attachment without losing an already-created issue
Document identity and references use one captured repository view
Projection convergence repairs missed hints without checkpointing incomplete or stale canonical content
Question answers preserve revision/receipt identity and distinguish applied answers from published files
Reader question votes remain personal advisory records bound to the resolved question revision
Home derives actionable approvals and owned-workspace questions under workspace visibility; loaded/filtered attention counts remain partial evidence.
Reusable explainer catalog combines built-ins and committed saved templates; owner edits remain live until ordinary publication.
Saving an explainer template requires explicit replacement of an existing user template and cannot overwrite built-in identities.
Browser telemetry rejects wrong credential classes and validates the whole batch before server-attributed emission.
Self-hosted provisioning returns the new license secret once and token admission checks entitlement and returns configured registry coordinates.
Attributed platform reports enter a durable queue; delivery reconciles uncertain provider creation before retry.
Shared quota admission locks and charges the complete key set together, rolling back all charges on refusal.
